'''2007 Utah State Championship Ryan Teels LS General Solo (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Ryan Teels]] at [[2007 Utah State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|General Solo (V) (Virtual Set 9: Sanctuary Moon)|OVS9-09-General_Solo-remaster.webp|label=General Solo (V)}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
